rent_1bed.label: Rent, one bedroom
rent_1bed.description: What a one-bedroom home costs to rent each month, from official rent statistics that measure either asking rents or the rents of all tenancies, with or without utilities, as each figure's source says.

rent_3bed.label: Rent, three bedrooms
rent_3bed.description: What a three-bedroom home costs to rent each month, from official rent statistics that measure either asking rents or the rents of all tenancies, with or without utilities, as each figure's source says.

childcare_fees_1.label: Childcare fees, one child
childcare_fees_1.description: What full-time childcare for one child aged 2 or 3 costs in fees a year, before any public support, in the place the OECD tax-benefit model takes as typical for the country.

childcare_fees_2.label: Childcare fees, two children
childcare_fees_2.description: Fees a year for full-time childcare for two children aged 2 and 3, before any public support (OECD tax-benefit model).

childcare_net_couple_1.label: Childcare, net of support: couple, one child
childcare_net_couple_1.description: What full-time childcare for one child aged 2 or 3 costs a two-earner couple (on 100% and 67% of the average wage) a year after childcare benefits, tax breaks and other benefit changes (OECD net childcare cost).

childcare_net_couple_2.label: Childcare, net of support: couple, two children
childcare_net_couple_2.description: What full-time childcare for two children aged 2 and 3 costs a two-earner couple (on 100% and 67% of the average wage) a year after childcare benefits, tax breaks and other benefit changes (OECD net childcare cost).

childcare_net_single_1.label: Childcare, net of support: single parent, one child
childcare_net_single_1.description: What full-time childcare for one child aged 2 or 3 costs a single parent on the average wage a year after childcare benefits, tax breaks and other benefit changes (OECD net childcare cost).

childcare_net_single_2.label: Childcare, net of support: single parent, two children
childcare_net_single_2.description: What full-time childcare for two children aged 2 and 3 costs a single parent on the average wage a year after childcare benefits, tax breaks and other benefit changes (OECD net childcare cost).

health_oop.label: Out-of-pocket health spending
health_oop.description: What people pay for health care themselves each year, per person, on average across the country: deductibles, co-payments and care not covered, but not insurance premiums.

childcare_cost.label: Your childcare cost
childcare_cost.description: What your household actually pays for childcare each month, after any public support: yours to set, and it replaces the OECD reference household's figure.

health_premium.label: Health insurance premium
health_premium.description: What your household pays each month for health insurance bought outside pay (a US plan, Swiss or Dutch basic insurance): yours to set, since no open source gives it per person.

annual_leave.label: Paid holiday by law
annual_leave.description: The fewest paid days of holiday an employer must give a full-time employee on a five-day week, from the country's labour law; contracts and collective agreements often give more.

public_holidays.label: Public holidays on working days
public_holidays.description: Public holidays that fall on a weekday this year, nationwide plus those of the city's region; a holiday on a weekend is lost unless the law moves it.

leave_mothers.label: Paid leave for mothers
leave_mothers.description: Paid maternity, parental and home-care leave a mother can take, counted as weeks at full pay (weeks times the average payment rate for someone on average earnings).

leave_fathers.label: Paid leave for fathers
leave_fathers.description: Paid paternity leave and parental leave reserved for fathers, counted as weeks at full pay (weeks times the average payment rate for someone on average earnings).

price_level.label: Price level
price_level.description: How expensive everyday consumption is, compared with the United States at market exchange rates.

temp_high.label: Average daily high (air)
temp_high.description: Air temperature 2 m above the ground in the shade, as a weather station measures it: the average of each day's highest reading, by month.

temp_low.label: Average daily low (air)
temp_low.description: Air temperature 2 m above the ground in the shade: the average of each day's lowest reading, by month.

feels_high.label: Average daily high (feels like)
feels_high.description: How warm the hottest part of the day feels to a person, once humidity, wind and sun are added to the air temperature (apparent temperature): the average of each day's highest, by month.

feels_low.label: Average daily low (feels like)
feels_low.description: How cold the coldest part of the day feels to a person, once humidity and wind are added to the air temperature (apparent temperature): the average of each day's lowest, by month.

temp_hourly.label: Average temperature by hour (air)
temp_hourly.description: Air temperature at each hour of the local day, averaged over every day of each month: what a typical January 8 am or July 3 pm is like.

temp_high_p10.label: Cool daily highs (air)
temp_high_p10.description: Air temperature in the shade: one day in ten has a high below this, by month (10th percentile of daily highs).

temp_high_p90.label: Hot daily highs (air)
temp_high_p90.description: Air temperature in the shade: one day in ten has a high above this, by month (90th percentile of daily highs).

temp_low_p10.label: Cold daily lows (air)
temp_low_p10.description: Air temperature in the shade: one night in ten drops below this, by month (10th percentile of daily lows).

temp_low_p90.label: Warm daily lows (air)
temp_low_p90.description: Air temperature in the shade: one night in ten stays above this, by month (90th percentile of daily lows).

temp_record_high.label: Highest high (air)
temp_record_high.description: The hottest air temperature in the shade reached in each month over the last five full years; older records can be higher.

temp_record_low.label: Lowest low (air)
temp_record_low.description: The coldest air temperature in the shade reached in each month over the last five full years; older records can be lower.

nice_bins_feels.label: Dry, mostly clear days by feels-like temperature
nice_bins_feels.description: Days with under 1 mm of rain and at most 50% of the sky clouded on average from 8 am to 8 pm, counted by how warm that time feels on average, one whole degree at a time from -5 to 40 °C, by month: your comfortable range picks the nice days from it.

nice_bins_air.label: Dry, mostly clear days by air temperature
nice_bins_air.description: Days with under 1 mm of rain and at most 50% of the sky clouded on average from 8 am to 8 pm, counted by the average air temperature in the shade over that time, one whole degree at a time from -5 to 40 °C, by month.

beach_days.label: Beach days
beach_days.description: Days that are dry (under 1 mm of rain), mostly sunny (at most 40% of the sky clouded on average) and feel between 24 and 32 °C on average from 8 am to 8 pm: weather for a beach or an outdoor pool.

active_days.label: Run or ride days
active_days.description: Days with at least 2 hours in a row between 6 am and 9 pm that are dry, not windy (under 30 km/h) and feel between 5 and 22 °C: good for a run or a bike ride.

muggy_days.label: Muggy days
muggy_days.description: Days whose average dew point is 18 °C or more: the air holds so much water that it feels sticky and sweat dries slowly.

grey_days.label: Grey days
grey_days.description: Days when cloud covers at least 80% of the sky on average from 8 am to 8 pm.

hot_nights.label: Hot nights
hot_nights.description: Nights when the air never cools below 20 °C, which makes sleeping without air conditioning hard (climatologists call them tropical nights).

hot_days.label: Heat-stress days
hot_days.description: Days when the feels-like temperature reaches 32 °C or more from 8 am to 8 pm, where heat starts to strain the body.

snow_days.label: Snow days
snow_days.description: Days with at least 1 cm of fresh snow.

windy_days.label: Windy days
windy_days.description: Days when the wind averages 30 km/h or more from 8 am to 8 pm, a fresh breeze in which small trees sway and umbrellas struggle.

cloud_cover.label: Cloud cover
cloud_cover.description: How much of the sky is covered by cloud, averaged over every hour of the month, day and night.

wet_days.label: Wet days
wet_days.description: Days a year with at least 1 mm of rain or snow, enough to wet the ground.

wet_days_monthly.label: Wet days by month
wet_days_monthly.description: Days with at least 1 mm of rain or snow, by month.

sunshine_hours.label: Sunshine
sunshine_hours.description: Hours a year of bright, direct sun, measured at a weather station by the WMO definition: direct sunlight of at least 120 W/m², roughly when the sun is strong enough to cast a sharp shadow.

sunshine_monthly.label: Sunshine by month
sunshine_monthly.description: Hours of bright, direct sun in each month (WMO definition: direct sunlight of at least 120 W/m²), measured at a weather station.

pm25.label: Fine dust (PM2.5)
pm25.description: Fine dust in the air (particles under 2.5 micrometres, which reach the lungs), averaged over a year; the WHO guideline is 5 µg/m³.

homicide_rate.label: Homicides
homicide_rate.description: People killed on purpose each year per 100,000 residents, a common proxy for violent crime.

life_expectancy.label: Life expectancy
life_expectancy.description: How many years a baby born now would live on average if today's death rates held, for the whole country.

life_evaluation.label: Life satisfaction
life_evaluation.description: How satisfied people say they are with their life as a whole, on a scale from 0 to 10, averaged over the country.

research_output.label: Research output
research_output.description: Papers, patents and datasets published in a year by institutions in the city, per 100,000 residents.

builder_density.label: Research output per resident
builder_density.description: Research output of institutions in the city, per resident, on a 0 to 100 scale.

universities.label: Universities and colleges
universities.description: Higher-education organisations registered in the city in the Research Organization Registry, so counts follow how each country registers its institutions.

research_institutes.label: Research institutes
research_institutes.description: Research facilities (institutes, laboratories, observatories) registered in the city in the Research Organization Registry; national research councils that register every lab inflate some cities (Paris, Tokyo).

founders_running_club.label: Founders Running Club
founders_running_club.description: Whether the Founders Running Club, a running community for founders, lists a chapter in the city.

coworking.label: Coworking spaces
coworking.description: Coworking spaces mapped in OpenStreetMap within 10 km of the centre.

climbing_gyms.label: Climbing gyms
climbing_gyms.description: Indoor climbing and bouldering gyms mapped in OpenStreetMap within 10 km of the centre.

swimming_pools.label: Public swimming pools
swimming_pools.description: Swimming centres and pools open to the public, mapped in OpenStreetMap within 10 km of the centre.

public_pools.label: Public swimming pools (official)
public_pools.description: Public swimming pools, indoor and outdoor, per 100,000 residents, as reported by the city to the Eurostat Urban Audit.

hackerspaces.label: Hackerspaces and makerspaces
hackerspaces.description: Community workshops for building things, mapped in OpenStreetMap within 10 km of the centre.

green_space_10km.label: Green space
green_space_10km.description: Share of the land within 10 km of the centre that is park, woodland, heath or other public green space in OpenStreetMap; the sea is left out of the land.

green_share.label: Green urban areas (official)
green_share.description: Share of the city's area that is green urban space or sports and leisure land, from the EU Urban Atlas via Eurostat.

sea_km.label: Distance to the sea
sea_km.description: Straight-line distance from the centre to the open-sea coast; lakes and tidal rivers do not count.

mountain_km.label: Distance to the mountains
mountain_km.description: Straight-line distance from the centre to ground that rises 1,000 m above it; 300 means none within 300 km.

airport_km.label: Nearest major airport
airport_km.description: Straight-line distance from the centre to the nearest large airport with scheduled flights.

airports_100km.label: Airports within 100 km
airports_100km.description: Airports with scheduled passenger flights within 100 km of the centre.

rail_stations.label: Rail and metro stations
rail_stations.description: Train, metro and light-rail stations mapped in OpenStreetMap within 10 km of the centre.

cycle_paths_km.label: Cycle paths
cycle_paths_km.description: Length of paths built or signed for bicycles, mapped in OpenStreetMap within 10 km of the centre; painted lanes on roads are not counted.

transit_commute_share.label: Commuting by public transport
transit_commute_share.description: Share of journeys to work made by bus, tram, metro or train.

commute_minutes.label: Commute time
commute_minutes.description: Average time of a journey to work, one way.

transit_pass.label: Monthly transit pass
transit_pass.description: Price of a monthly pass for all public transport in the central zone (5 to 10 km).

road_deaths.label: Road deaths
road_deaths.description: People killed in road accidents per 10,000 residents a year.

foreign_born_share.label: Born abroad
foreign_born_share.description: Share of residents born in another country: a measure of how international the city is.

english_share.label: English speakers
english_share.description: Share of the country's population that speaks English at any level; cities usually speak more than the national figure.

english_official.label: English is official
english_official.description: Whether English is an official or de facto official language of the country.

download_mbps.label: Internet speed
download_mbps.description: Typical download speed of home and mobile connections in speed tests (M-Lab NDT, one TCP stream, so lower than commercial tests); compare cities with each other.

degree_share.label: Adults with a degree
degree_share.description: Share of adults whose highest qualification is tertiary, a university degree or a vocational diploma above school level (ISCED levels 5 to 8), counting people aged 25 to 64 for a city or region and 25 or older for a country.

github_developers.label: Developers on GitHub
github_developers.description: GitHub accounts whose profile names the city as their location, per 1,000 residents: a rough count of people who write software there, since many leave the field empty and some name a city they only live near.

walkable_share.label: Everyday needs on foot
walkable_share.description: Share of residential streets within 5 km of the centre from which a food shop, a pharmacy or doctor, a school, a park and a bus, tram or train stop are each within 1 km as the crow flies (about a 15-minute walk), as mapped in OpenStreetMap.

bike_network.label: Cycle network
bike_network.description: Length of cycle paths, and of cycle tracks kept apart from traffic beside roads, per km² of land within 10 km of the centre, as mapped in OpenStreetMap; painted lanes are not counted.

active_commute_share.label: Walking or cycling to work
active_commute_share.description: Share of journeys to work made mainly on foot or by bicycle.

city_edge_km.label: Out of the dense city
city_edge_km.description: Straight-line distance from the centre to the nearest edge of the dense city (the GHSL urban centre: touching 1 km squares with at least 1,500 residents per km²) in a direction that leads on over land, so roughly what a cyclist rides before the dense city gives way to suburbs, farmland, hills or a large park.

politics_lr.label: Politics, left to right
politics_lr.description: An estimate of where the place voted at its latest national lower-house election (a Swiss canton, Canadian province or Australian state at its own count), on a scale from 0, left, to 10, right: each party's ParlGov position (the mean of expert surveys, or of its party family where no survey covers it), averaged by its share of the official result.

abortion_law.label: Abortion in law
abortion_law.description: On what grounds the law allows a pregnancy to be ended: 0 not at all or only to save the woman's life, 1 also to protect her health or after rape or incest, 2 also on broad social or economic grounds, 3 on request but only in the first weeks (under 10), 4 on request to 10 weeks or later.

doctors.label: Doctors
doctors.description: Practising physicians per 1,000 people in the country, generalists and specialists (WHO figures).

unemployment.label: Unemployment
unemployment.description: Share of people who want work and are looking for it but have none, in the country (ILO modelled estimate).

clean_government.label: Control of corruption
clean_government.description: How far public power is kept from private gain, petty and grand corruption alike, as experts, firms and households perceive it in the country: the World Bank's governance estimate, roughly -2.5 (weak) to 2.5 (strong).

same_sex_couples.label: Same-sex couples in law
same_sex_couples.description: What the law offers same-sex couples: 0 sexual relations between people of the same sex are a crime, 1 legal but national law offers no union, 2 civil union or registered partnership, 3 marriage.
